verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers cap table management, fundraising modeling, SAFEs, 409A valuations, and liquidity programs, but contains no mention of an employee-facing portal showing personal grants, vesting schedules, strike price, or scenario-based equity value projections. The closest item (pulley-docs-4) describes an admin clicking a stakeholder name to view a profile, not a self-service employee view. Missing for 10: any documentation of an employee/stakeholder self-service portal, vesting progress display, strike price disclosure, or 'what could my equity be worth' scenario tool for individual employees.
